body:
The session added a lineage registry: viola run takes --parent NAME and --role WORD, else reads the inherited VIOLA_NAME as the parent only, and a parent equal to the instance's own name is a usage error, exit 2, before anything is read.
Every run and revive start now writes three records before the hook's session-start instead of two: the wheel start line, then one lineage line (source wrapper, data parent and role), then session-start; the snapshot gains lineage and the replay recovers it as a fourth field.
The lineage kind is the sixteenth product event kind (15 to 16), log-only, waking no wait; it writes no process-log line, no span and no terminal byte.

revive keeps the recorded parent and role; the test harness supervisor now drops the inherited VIOLA_NAME, VIOLA_DIR and VIOLA_BIN when it spawns a wrapper, so a harness session started inside a wrapped session records no parent.
Nothing was retired; no config key, env var, closed word, dependency or process-log event was added.

body_fields.fact: The lineage event kind (the 16th) carries data parent and role, each a string or null, written with source wrapper. It is log-only and not a wake kind.
viola run takes --parent NAME (a viola name) and --role WORD (a code word). A --parent equal to the instance's own name is a usage error (exit 2) before anything is read.
With no --parent flag, viola run takes the inherited VIOLA_NAME as the parent only (never as the role), and drops it when it equals the instance's own name.
viola revive keeps the parent and role recorded in the real snapshot.
The replay takes the last lineage line. A later line with no parent clears it, so a reused name started without a parent has none.

The viola list human board draws each wrapped row under its parent, depth-first, in the board's name order, with NAME indented two spaces per depth. A row whose parent has no wrapped row is a root, and cycle members are drawn once from the first in order.
The viola list human board prints a -- LINKS -- separator, then one driver -> driven line per link, after the board and the unwrapped rack, with no SGR. There is no block when there are no links.

list --json and MCP list items carry parent and role only when present. A parent is kept only when it parses as a viola name other than the row's own, and a role only when it passes the code-word check.

list --json ok.links is the union of every listed live or stale instance's links, sorted by driver then driven, deduplicated, with each pair kept only when both names parse. A gone instance gives none, and the key is omitted when empty.
An e2e census test holds that no wheel, link, send or answer path reads lineage. It is proven to bite by a planted hit.
The harness supervisor's wrapper spawn removes the inherited VIOLA_NAME, VIOLA_DIR and VIOLA_BIN, so a harness session booted inside a wrapped session records no parent on its instances.
